summary: Expedited RCU GP selection publishes rcu_node::exp_tasks while RCU read-unlock/deferred QS paths update the same pointer as blocked tasks drain.

call_chain.evidence: removes task from blocked lists and advances exp_tasks
expedited GP worker registered in sync_rcu_exp_select_cpus

interleaving: An expedited GP worker selects CPUs and, if blocked readers exist, stores rnp->exp_tasks from blkd_tasks.
A task exiting an RCU read-side critical section advances or clears rnp->exp_tasks.
Other stall/boost readers also traverse or test exp_tasks; the fix adds READ_ONCE/WRITE_ONCE and locks stall traversal.

ground_truth_access.required_ordering: exp_tasks publication/advancement must use WRITE_ONCE and lock-protected traversal/READ_ONCE for lockless readers.

vulnerability_surface.why_relevant: exp_tasks is the shared list cursor for tasks blocking an expedited grace period and is the field explicitly annotated/locked by the patch.

aliases.name: rnp->exp_tasks
aliases.evidence: expedited GP worker sets pointer from rnp->blkd_tasks.next

aliases.name: rnp->exp_tasks
aliases.evidence: read-unlock deferred QS advances the pointer when current task unblocks

aliases.name: t->rcu_node_entry
aliases.evidence: task list node compared against exp_tasks

allocated_by: rcu_init_one initializes rcu_node tree and blkd_tasks list
published_by: expedited GP selection and preempt RCU queueing publish exp_tasks
invalidated_by: deferred QS advances/clears exp_tasks as readers unblock
freed_by: static rcu_node tree persists for kernel lifetime

coverage.analysis_conclusion: tree_exp.h defines expedited GP worker access; tree_plugin.h defines read-unlock/deferred QS and boost/stall readers; tree.c includes both headers and supplies the selected compiled TU.

patch_hunks: WRITE_ONCE added to exp_tasks stores; READ_ONCE/data_race added to readers; rcu_print_task_exp_stall now locks rnp while traversing exp_tasks/blkd_tasks.
indirect_edges: INIT_WORK(&rnp->rew.rew_work, sync_rcu_exp_select_node_cpus) registers expedited GP worker; __rcu_read_unlock calls deferred QS when needed.
entry_discovery_log: tree_repair.ll contains __rcu_read_unlock, rcu_preempt_deferred_qs_irqrestore, rcu_preempt_ctxt_queue, sync_rcu_exp_select_node_cpus, rcu_print_task_exp_stall, and rcu_boost_kthread.
repair_commands: compiled kernel/rcu/tree.c with clang-15 and CONFIG_PREEMPT_RCU/CONFIG_RCU_BOOST to tree_repair.ll after applying an initcall override header in the temp worktree
notes: The original tree.ll lacked PREEMPT_RCU/RCU_BOOST-only functions; tree_repair.ll is selected for final coverage.
